verdict.rationale: Segment documents official libraries spanning web (JavaScript), mobile (Kotlin for Android, Swift) and server (C#, Java), with a track call example. The Segment Spec gives guidance on what data to capture and how to format it across all its libraries and APIs, and identity resolution covers web, mobile and server touch-points. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the identify and page calls within the Spec, per-SDK reference detail, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK collection.
